relationships.subject: CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: This work shows that CB2 is necessary for the protection against neuropathic pain observed in Fmr1KO mice

key_findings: Partial CB2 deletion abolished the protection against nerve-injury hypersensitivity in Fmr1KO mice.
Pain-induced depressive-like behaviour was absent in Fmr1KO but present in Fmr1KO-HzCB2 mice.
